description: Query JSON with JSONPath (RFC 9535): dot and bracket names, indexes, slices, wildcards, recursive descent (..) and filters with comparisons, && || !, and length() / count() / match() / search() / value() functions, e.g. $.store.book[?@.price < 10].title. Returns matched values with their normalized paths. Several queries per call. POST JSON body {json, query}. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/jsonpath

queries.description: Several expressions at once (alternative to query)
